services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: We welcome you to attend the grand opening of our upcoming exhibit celebrating the 250th anniversary of the Juan Bautista De Anza Expedition passing through Cupertino (March 25-27), and the United States Semiquincentennial! Come see a uniform worn by the reenactors of the expedition in 1976 and much more on display
